description: Implementation of MojoAudioDecoder class for media decoding, including initialization, decoding, reset, and connection handling.

classes.name: MojoAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class that implements an audio decoder using Mojo IPC, managing initialization, decoding, reset, and connection error handling.

methods.name: MojoAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MojoAudioDecoder with task runner, media log, and remote decoder.

methods.name: IsPlatformDecoder
methods.description: Returns true indicating this is a platform decoder.

methods.name: SupportsDecryption
methods.description: Returns true if the decoder supports decryption; currently true only on Android.

methods.name: FailInit
methods.description: Handles initialization failure by posting a callback with error status.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, CDM context, and callbacks for output and waiting states.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a media buffer, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder, invoking a closure upon completion.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Indicates if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: BindRemoteDecoder
methods.description: Binds the remote decoder interface and sets up error handling and media log.

methods.name: OnBufferDecoded
methods.description: Callback when a buffer has been decoded, passes output to the output callback.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Handles connection errors with the remote decoder.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Callback after initialization, sets up data pipe if successful.
